notes: Budgets for the counter run (application/ui/src/specs/counters/), set from its reading on main 1f9cda38, after B (telemetry out of the status key) and D (keyed telemetry) cut Grid's notifications from 11271 to 78; the first baseline was taken on a1fbfdaf. scripts/benchmark/ checks them. A count past its budget warns, and one past twice it fails the build (failsAt in scripts/benchmark/counters.ts: loose by choice while the product is early, the user's call on 2026-10-17); one under it asks for the budget to come down.

Work that really adds cost raises a budget in the same pull request, written { "budget": n, "reason": "why", "from": "#PR" } naming that pull request (on main, any source but the raise it replaces); the checker shows every changed budget, old to new, and fails a raise that does not say why and where from.

notifications and mutations are totals over a phase's telemetry ticks, whose number each phase's `ticks` records: a script that plays another number fails until its budgets are set for it. bytes are what the runner's streams sent the UI in the phase; streaming counts attached streams at the phase's peak and once it settles.
switches.streamingSettled is 4 on purpose: Focus keeps its last 4 shown terminals mounted, and their streams stay live (performance rule 8). A change that parks them shows as under budget.
